item.description:
## Worksheets - Double-click an exercise to edit it on the grid. Every change is saved into that exercise, with a banner above the grid and a Done button. - Drag exercise cards to reorder them. A blue line shows where the exercise will land. - Rename an exercise with the pencil beside its name, or right-click > Rename Exercise. - Replacing an exercise keeps its name and only updates the notation. - Card icons are visible in dark mode and when a card is selected.
## Printing - Worksheets print on exactly the pages they need, with no blank page at the end. - Exercises are centred on the page, with matching left and right margins. - The dot of a dotted rest sits next to the rest in printed worksheets.
## Notation - Put a Pedal Hi-Hat (foot) note where an open hi-hat closes: the foot shows below the stave and a "+" above it at the same beat. - The Close tool moves the "+" to the note you mark, instead of adding a second one. - Sticking letters sit clear of hi-hat "o" and "+" marks and accents, on screen and in print.
## Also since 1.0 (133) - Song Chart Builder tempo slider and drag-to-change tempo. - Safer saving: if your library can't be read in full, BeatBake keeps a copy of the original and opens everything it can. - Groove undo goes back 100 steps. Chart Builder navigation, Delete Bar and faster long charts.
This build is 146.
